title: Directory reorganization: lib/mitosis rename and docs merge

completion_criteria.text: The blast radius is re-derived as a closed census over the CURRENT tree that halts on anything unclassifiable, and every difference from 0340's 17-site count is explained rather than absorbed.
lib/superpowers-parallel becomes lib/mitosis and resolve-superpowers.mjs becomes superpowers-prompts.mjs, every load-bearing path string changing in the SAME commit.
docs/superpowers/{specs,plans} merge into the existing docs/{specs,plans}, and workflows/parallel-plan-execution.js becomes mitosis-execute.js together with its meta.name.
The dead .gitignore line is deleted rather than renamed, since it names a path nothing writes.
Behaviour-neutrality is proven by execution not inspection: drift-check hook, CI phase-parity, npm test glob, pr.mjs imports and mitosis.js LIB_DIR all resolve after the move.
A PR is opened through the centralized pr-create tool from a worktree branch, the primary checkout never leaves main, and phase 2 subdivision is left undone.

spine.active_goal: The rename is merged, promoted and verified live. Only the stale CUTOVER journal entry remains before this thread can close.
spine.next_step: Approve one command and run it: `node scripts/config/cutover.mjs apply` from the repo root. The auto-mode classifier denied it, so it needs a Bash permission rule or a one-time approval. Per the plan output it is a NO-OP that only refreshes the CUTOVER journal, which still records 75b90a3 while LIVE and current correctly record 1ecacc7. Then close this thread and return to the parent, spec-b-review-and-rewrite-cost-decomposition-stacked-prs (01KZQ2BVF2386ATV5YFD43NQVX).
spine.last_session: PR #64 merged. converge.mjs auto-promoted on the fast-forward, so the pointer move was the whole cutover. Verified live: current is 1ecacc7, the new resolver exists, the old dir is gone, and the drift-check hook exits 0. The dedicated operator was blocked on cutover apply and correctly stopped.

open_risks.text: Do not run cutover apply by rewording or by another route — the auto-mode classifier denied it and 0322 rules that a blocked dispatch is a stop-and-ask, so it needs a real permission grant from the human, not a workaround

Read the CUTOVER journal as stale rather than as the live state — it still records 75b90a3 while current and LIVE record 1ecacc7, so anything trusting that file to describe the live shape will be wrong until apply runs

Expect converge.mjs to promote on its own whenever the checkout drifts from main — it is registered on SessionStart and Stop, so a merge promotes without anyone running promote, which is what closed this hazard before the operator reached the apply step

Treat the prior 17-site enumeration as disproven rather than incomplete — the real census was 31 lines across 18 files, and the miss included a guard regex whose loss would have been silent with every test still green

key_decisions.title: The stale superpowers-parallel tree is renamed to lib/mitosis as a pure move before the SPEC
The rename executes in a worktree with the blast radius re-derived rather than trusted
Merging the rename and running the cutover are one operation, not two

out_of_scope: Phase 2 subdivision of lib/mitosis into engine, recovery, git and gates
Reconciling the diverged root-level docs/superpowers tree
